pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Chautari Creative, Jhamsikhel: brand, web and film for Nepali companies
pages.seoDescription: Creative studio in Jhamsikhel, Lalitpur. Brand identity from Rs 3.5 lakh, websites from Rs 2 lakh, brand films. About eight projects a year.

props.title: We make Nepali companies look like they mean it
props.text: Identity, websites and short films for hotels, banks, cooperatives and the people who supply them. Seven of us, eight projects a year, no juniors on your account.

items.title: Brand identity
items.text: Name, logo, colours, type, a usable guideline. Signage and packaging follow.

items.title: Websites
items.text: Designed, written and built. You can edit it yourself afterwards.

items.title: Brand film
items.text: Two to four minutes, shot in Nepal with Nepali crew. Subtitled in English.

items.title: Campaign design
items.text: Print, hoardings and social for a Dashain or Tihar season.

props.heading: The shape of the studio
props.text: Small on purpose. We would rather do eight projects properly than twenty in a hurry.

props.title: Have a brief? Send it as it is.
props.text: One paragraph is enough. We reply in two working days.
